scope: Independent readonly full staging-entry and exact build02/artifact/result-mode delta review; not a full controller re-review or actual namespace run
delta_only_behavior: Newly created result descriptor fchmod(0444) after flushing, before close; owning directory remains private until original retirement/final publication path.
checks: Full stage verifies exact command arguments and full controller hash before any fresh source directory/file creation, uses create-only no-follow/CLOEXEC file creation under a new root-owned 0700 directory, checks stored bytes and executes the already verified in-memory source.
The fixed request contains only the expected owned runtime root/source, one CPU, 512 MiB, nice10 and180-second tool timeout. No alternate command or automatic retry is introduced.

make_elfs still reads exact pinned build/audit records, requires successful unchanged-source build and clean worker closure, verifies each artifact content hash/size/ELF magic against the fixed constants and build record, then seals a root-owned private memfd.
save is called only for runtime-result.json, created with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW relative to the held new output directory. Mode update targets that already owned descriptor, not an unrelated path.

Output is the own synthetic factory/client protocol and captured owned-child stdout/stderr plus Main framework/cgroup identity metadata. No commercial App journal/log/tombstone collector was added; complete activation body is not stored.
actual_build02_pins_authority: Parent supplied exact actual-build02 pins; this review verified the full source/request use of them, and runtime retains strict byte comparison. No additional remote read was performed.
